topic.description: a subject in the knowledge graph. Any entity may be one by wearing this: a subject of its own is topic + doc + content, and a project is its own topic, so what is known about it sits under it. What a topic belongs to is whatever contains it: one about a project sits under the project, and one about the world under none. Its doc is the cover: the title, and a line or two saying what belongs under it. Its content.body is the contents: what is understood about it, written as one document citing its sources. Its edges say what it holds (contains: a subtopic, or anything else, such as a memory, a design, a skill, a package or somebody's words), what to understand first (requires), what it reads or references, and what it cites; beliefs are about it (belief.about). A session opened on it (session.topic) starts from its tree, compiled (topic_read)

name.description: the title in lowercase, its spaces single; no two topics share one, so a name said again finds the topic that has it. A name, not an identity: it changes with the title, and the entity keeps its eid

topic.description: the topic it was opened on: the topic tree compiled from it (topic_read) opens its context, after its persona's

topic_read.title: Read a topic as a session's context
topic_read.description: Compile session context as content.body: ancestors, cover, contents with $was, held entities, subtopic outline, prerequisites, related entities and sources. Long bodies are shortened with ids to read the rest.

topic_new.title: Make a topic
topic_new.description: Create a subject with a short cover where no topic fits. Duplicate or overlapping names refuse with the existing topic. A project is already its own topic; topic_add places subtopics under it. Returns applied bundles.

name.description: what the topic is called, a few plain words

body.description: a line or two saying what belongs under it

topic_find.title: Find topics
topic_find.description: Find whole topics by stemmed or prefix words in name, title or cover. near ranks by meaning with vectors; otherwise name order. Use before topic_new or topic_add to reuse an existing subject.

said.description: words the topic's name, title or cover holds, as the start of a word or by its stem

near.description: an entity id or name whose meaning ranks the topics

topic_add.title: Add to a topic
topic_add.description: Add contains edges from a topic or project to entities; drop removes them. Repeated additions are idempotent; entities may belong to several topics. Returns applied bundles.

topic.description: the topic's id or title, or a project's

ids.description: the entities to put under it, by id

drop.description: take them out of the topic instead
